name: smaily/smaily-wordpress-plugin
description: The Smaily plugin integrates Contact Form 7 and WooCommerce, offering a complete email marketing and automation solution

scripts.extract-text-domain: wp i18n make-pot . languages/smaily-connect.pot && msginit -i languages/smaily-connect.pot -o languages/smaily-connect-en.po -l en --no-translator
scripts.compile-translations: rm -f languages/smaily-connect-en.po && wp i18n update-po languages/smaily-connect.pot languages/ && wp i18n make-mo languages/ && wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge
scripts.package:hash: git rev-parse --short HEAD > build-hash.txt 2>/dev/null && (git diff --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null || echo '-dirty' >> build-hash.txt) && tr -d '\n' < build-hash.txt > .bh.tmp && mv .bh.tmp build-hash.txt || echo 'dev' > build-hash.txt
scripts.package: composer run package:hash && rm -rf smaily-connect.zip && mkdir -p staging/smaily-connect && rsync -av --exclude-from=.zipignore --exclude=staging ./ staging/smaily-connect/ && composer run package:strip-map-refs && cd staging && zip -r ../smaily-connect.zip smaily-connect/ && cd .. && rm -rf staging
